properties.name: A check that could not run lands as blocked, and a blocked check is a gap that never says the part failed
properties.rationale: Root cause (fact:root-cause-a-check-that-did-not-run-reads-did-not-work-as-designed-because-only-failing-is-loud-2026-10-02), confirmed on main at 293f957: OBSERVED_OUTCOMES was passed/failed/skipped, run_to_files mapped every JUnit <error> to failed, and no detector read status blocked, so the honest status was quiet and the dishonest one loud (failing_verification: "did not work as designed"). THE CLASS covered: all three routes (reconcile, converter, detector). Deliberately left: an <error> raised while the test body ran (JUnit in Java) stays failed, because that test did run; a python script's non-zero exit stays failed, because the converter cannot tell why it exited. a_check_that_could_not_run_is_blocked.rs observed failing on main (4 of 5; the fifth is the regression guard).
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: reconcile_verification takes the outcome `blocked`; run_to_files.py writes it for pytest's collection-failure and failed-on-setup errors and for a cargo test target that never started; a Verification at status blocked raises the gap blocked_verification (0.65), which says nothing is known about the part and never that it failed. Verification.status now describes `blocked`.
